subject: Thursday campus visit options
text: Hello, I would like to arrange a campus visit for our club discussion group next Thursday. We can attend your available seminar period, but I need to check whether the library study room remains open until late. I have a club meeting the same day from three until four, and I was hoping the visit could follow it. If that is difficult, I can ask another member to confirm the room booking and arrive earlier. I have no problem traveling from the main campus after my obligation ends. I will follow your preferred time for the tour and meet outside the department office.
